field.label: Enabled
field.help: This will enable or disable the zone.

field.label: Name
field.help: Name of the RPZ zone (e.g. rpz.local). The zone file is expected at /usr/local/etc/namedb/primary/<name>.db.

field.label: Type
field.help: Feed zones are downloaded externally and are read-only here. Local zones are fully managed in this GUI via the Entries grid below.

field.label: Policy
field.help: Override policy applied to names matching this zone. Leave empty to use the zone's own CNAME records (given).
